svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Segoe UI Web, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Option C: custom PriceIntel AI platform on Azure
svg.desc: Executive view of PriceIntel AI: catalog import, permitted marketplace data collection, AI product matching, deterministic margin-aware pricing, and human approval before any price is published back to the HoppNShop store.
svg.metadata: version=1.0; updated=2026-11-06; generator=build_diagram.py; icons=Azure Architecture Icons V25 and Microsoft Entra icons (Oct 2023). Marketplace data sources and the store catalog are external systems and use neutral glyphs.

text.tspan: Option C: custom PriceIntel AI platform on Azure
HoppNShop catalog matched against Amazon, Walmart, and Target

svg.text: Shopify store -> catalog import: SKUs, specs, images, and costs arrive by the Shopify Admin API or CSV
Catalog import -> collectors: clean SKUs are queued for discovery on a per-category schedule
Marketplace data sources -> collectors: permitted APIs and licensed feeds return prices and offers
Collectors -> matching engine: candidate listings arrive with source URLs and timestamps
Matching engine -> AI services: text and image embeddings plus attribute extraction score each match
Matching engine -> pricing engine: only matches above the confidence threshold feed the benchmark
Pricing engine -> data and evidence: deterministic rules save benchmarks, status, and margin-safe prices
Data and evidence -> review dashboard: drill-down shows match evidence, price history, and rationale
Review dashboard -> pricing team: alerts and low-confidence items are routed for human review
Pricing team -> Shopify store: only approved prices are exported or published, with an audit trail
